name: COMP_007
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (58%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Invasive · Careful review
InSitu (35%) remains in the 90% conformal set [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 58%, InSitu 35% | Modest margin |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive | Not separated |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.96; OOD 94th percentile | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive [F5] | Support Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 5, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; largest concept contribution [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Elevated score, slightly negative concept-model weight · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 5, 7) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score; failed spot check · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Modest score; small positive concept-model weight · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitotic figures and normal lobules are Unreliable here.

## Could be wrong if
- Stromal infiltration is overcalled and the lesion is mostly in situ.
- Reliability ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69), so an unflagged input is weak assurance.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 10, 11:** confirm tumor cells infiltrate stroma rather than stay duct-confined.
2. **Region 0:** look for atypical cells confined within ducts.
3. **Regions 8–11:** highest heatmap contribution; confirm invasive carcinoma.
